title: commit-confluence: reproducibility artifact for a pre-registered study of calibrated early-response geometry
description:
Pre-registrations, gated evaluation data, registered per-deployment score matrices and calibration profiles, provenance manifests, and analysis code for a study of whether four families of internal signals read near the start of a model's response (attention morphology, residual-stream motion, readout geometry, and the model's own confidence) combine into one calibrated discriminator, and whether that discriminator transfers across models or must be calibrated per deployment.

What is measured, stated first. Every task supplies the candidate under judgement in the prompt: the HaluEval families pair a correct against a hallucinated answer, summary or response; ANLI supplies a premise and hypothesis; TriviaQA pairs a question with either its answer or a distractor. The label discriminated is therefore a property of the supplied input, not whether the model under test hallucinated in its own free generation. This artifact does not contain evidence about free-generation hallucination detection.

Registered outcomes, including the failures. The confidence-free geometric dispatcher clears its registered discrimination criterion on 18/20 sealed deployments (bar 17/20) while the stricter all-signals claim is falsified (18/20 against a 19/20 bar). No single signal is best (12 distinct winners). On a third construct, per-model calibration passes 10/10 but one frozen cell with one frozen sign fails at 6/10, because four models read the shared signal in the opposite direction; both replication endpoints miss their bar at 7/20.

Not peer reviewed. Research artifact and supporting code. Analysis code is MIT; data and results artifacts are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE for the split and for upstream dataset terms: ANLI CC BY-NC 4.0, TriviaQA Apache-2.0, HaluEval MIT).
notes: The tag prereg-seal-20260612 is the commit from which the registered run was executed (seed 20260612). Every registered endpoint and descriptive probe re-runs from this repository alone, with no model inference. ORCID for the creator is to be added by the author before publishing.
